samples.question: The picture shows four straight coloured segments, one red, one green, one blue and one orange, and a single solid black vertical line near the right-hand edge which is the FINISH LINE. Every coloured segment stops well short of the finish line and never touches it. Continue each segment to the right as a straight line, keeping exactly its own slope, until it meets the finish line; the row where it meets the finish line is that colour's ARRIVAL HEIGHT, and a smaller row, that is a point nearer the top of the picture, counts as HIGHER. All four extensions arrive inside the picture. The four drawn segments never cross and never touch one another, so their drawn top-to-bottom order is the same everywhere they are inked; that drawn order is NOT the answer, because a lower segment that rises more steeply can arrive above a higher one. Segment length, how far right a segment reaches, and which segment is drawn highest are all uninformative. The pale grey dashed horizontal lines and the black horizontal rail along the bottom are decoration and carry no information. Which colour arrives highest on the finish line? Answer red, green, blue or orange.
